title: What the Moon Bear keeps

is_this_you.pressure: When the ground turns loud, you climb first and decide later. From up there you can wait out almost anything.
is_this_you.love: You let one or two people up into your branches. Everyone else gets the warmth on your chest and no address.
is_this_you.cost: You hold the hard winter alone, then come down in spring as if nothing happened.

opener.text: Hunters in the mountains of Niigata said the mountain god gave this bear an amulet wrapped in silk, and the white crescent is where it lay [s5]. Your own sign is ruled by the Moon [s1]. So the moon you were born under was pressed onto you as a gift. You carry it slowly, and with care.

howto: Three parts. Go slowly. They will wait for you.

tabs.label: The crescent
tabs.intro: Water underneath. Wood standing up out of it.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, ruled by the Moon, a soft core kept inside a shell [s1] [s2]. The Tiger is yang Wood, brave, and slow to keep close friends [s3] [s4]. In you the Water keeps the Wood alive. You are gentle first, and fierce only on behalf of something gentle.

The same hunters held that a bear with no crescent, minaguro, all black, was the most sacred [s5]. A hunter who killed one by mistake offered it to the god and gave up hunting [s5]. Part of you wishes you could go unread like that. The other part knows the mark is how the right people find you.

tabs.label: The cave
tabs.intro: Up into the branches, then down into the dark.

rows.text: A moon bear breaks branches into a feeding platform high in a tree, and rests on it [s11]. When threatened, it climbs [s11]. So do you. Before you argue, you get height, and you watch until the ground goes still.
In the colder north of its range the bear dens through winter in a hollow tree or a cave [s11] [s10]. Some winters you need the dark for months too. You come out thinner and surer.

Mencius liked fish and bear's paw, and if he could not have both he would let the fish go [s7]. The saying is 魚與熊掌 (yú yǔ xióngzhǎng), and he meant choosing what is right over his own life [s7]. Offered safe or loyal, you take loyal and pay for it in private.
Your gift is guarding something soft without a show. Rescue work, child protection and keeping a small inn all fit. Watch the Tiger pride that turns down help.

tabs.label: Who you let in
tabs.intro: Three who can share the den. One who wants your branch.
tabs.love_lead: In love you shield first and talk later. You need someone who does not follow you up the tree, and who knows a retreat is not a verdict. Three matches come straight from the old tables.

easy.why: The Orca (Scorpio, Horse year) shares your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Scorpio is Water like you [s3] [s1].
The Beluga (Pisces, Dog year) closes the Tiger's trine, and Pisces makes the third Water sign [s3] [s1].
The Deep Sea Anglerfish (Scorpio, Pig year) is your secret friend, since the Pig is the Tiger's hidden ally, and Scorpio is Water too [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Snowy Owl (Capricorn, Monkey year): the Monkey clashes with the Tiger, and Capricorn sits across the sky from Cancer [s3] [s1].

story.text: In Korea's founding myth a bear and a tiger were sent into a cave with mugwort and garlic, to become human [s6]. The tiger grew restless and walked out [s6]. The bear stayed, became a woman, and bore Tangun, the founder of Korea [s6]. You were born with both animals in one body.

closing: Let the tiger pace. Stay in the cave until spring, and come out as yourself.
